svg.aria-label: Three panels, one per quality axis, each with its own 95% confidence interval (±1.96·√(p(1−p)/n) over the item count) and its own Pareto front — the dotted line, on which no model is both smaller and better. Each front is labelled at its two ends only; Table 2 carries every point with its footprint. The shaded band and the dashed line mark a 16 GiB card's 15 GiB budget. A point's horizontal position is its footprint — weights plus its KV cache at its context plus the 1 GiB overhead (§2) — so a model with expensive attention sits further right than its file size suggests. The same ten models appear in all three panels — the MTP arm has no quality row — so only the vertical axis changes
svg.title: Three panels, one per quality axis, each with its own 95% confidence interval (±1.96·√(p(1−p)/n) over the item count) and its own Pareto front — the dotted line, on which no model is both smaller and better. Each front is labelled at its two ends only; Table 2 carries every point with its footprint. The shaded band and the dashed line mark a 16 GiB card's 15 GiB budget. A point's horizontal position is its footprint — weights plus its KV cache at its context plus the 1 GiB overhead (§2) — so a model with expensive attention sits further right than its file size suggests. The same ten models appear in all three panels — the MTP arm has no quality row — so only the vertical axis changes
svg.desc: Three panels, one per quality axis, each with its own 95% confidence interval (±1.96·√(p(1−p)/n) over the item count) and its own Pareto front — the dotted line, on which no model is both smaller and better. Each front is labelled at its two ends only; Table 2 carries every point with its footprint. The shaded band and the dashed line mark a 16 GiB card's 15 GiB budget. A point's horizontal position is its footprint — weights plus its KV cache at its context plus the 1 GiB overhead (§2) — so a model with expensive attention sits further right than its file size suggests. The same ten models appear in all three panels — the MTP arm has no quality row — so only the vertical axis changes — computed from the run archive, not drawn by hand.
